description: We’re a team from Hyderabad building for Flame in Freefall: AI-Powered Fire Safety Insights from Microgravity Combustion Data. Our plan is an interactive dashboard that pulls together NASA’s microgravity combustion findings, ranks them by relevance to spacecraft fire safety, and explains each result with links back to its source. We’re building it in Python (Streamlit) with a retrieval-based approach, so the insights stay traceable instead of invented.
